reviews.text: Baker Door Company was fantastic from start to finish. Casey explained everything that I could expect and Chris (and Casey) kept me updated on the status of my door.

reviews.text: Excellent installation of two new garage doors, as well as new openers that we had purchased ourselves. The installers did an excellent job and all with a smile even though it took longer than expected due to having to trouble shoot some issues.
reviews.author: Lisa C.
